_README: The forecaster this project is pinned to, and the checks it passed. No forecast threshold is tuned until confirmed is true for the option-set size in use. Log-probabilities are NOT used: every Gemini route refuses them and they are deprecated on the 3.x line (PREREG Phase B).
scorer: declared ranking -> geometric rank map, THETA fitted on dev

large_k.note: The responsive/oracle arm at large k was MIS-SPECIFIED: the 'true portfolio' named the actual target power outright, so responsive 0.960 and top-1 0.920 measure instruction-following, not motive inference. They are NOT a ceiling and are not quoted. aligned, stable and permutation do not depend on portfolio content and stand.

positional_bias.reading: NOT a positional prior. The instability is order SENSITIVITY as VARIANCE -- the ranking differs between renderings without favouring early letters -- which is why averaging reduces it roughly as 1/sqrt(R) and a positional de-biasing correction would not have helped.
